about: The executive of a body whose row in OPD's bodies export names none (executive_name and executive_name_<lang> empty) and whose affairs' OPD events do not name it either; used by gegenprobe.schema.v0_2_meta for qa[].answering_body (route metadata, source gegenprobe:data/schema/body_executives.json#<key>). Every other body's executive comes from OPD's own bodies export (data/schema/v0_2_meta_slice.json).

CHE.name: Bundesrat
CHE.basis: Federal Constitution Art. 174 (the Federal Council is the supreme governing and executive authority of the Confederation); the answers to federal interventions in OPD's texts export are the Federal Council's (Curia Vista 'Antwort des Bundesrates')
